definitions.gloss: to misspeak; to say (something) wrong; to get (a word) wrong when speaking
definitions.explanation: To say the wrong word, name, or number by mistake while speaking.

examples.japanese: ⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{言|い}い⟦{間違|まちが}えた→間違える：01109_machigaeru⟧。
⟦{緊張|きんちょう}して→緊張する：20557_kinchousuru⟧⟦{数字|すうじ}→数字：03361_suuji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{言|い}い⟦{間違|まちが}えて→間違える：01109_machigaeru⟧しまった。
examples.english: I was nervous and said the wrong number.

examples.japanese: ⟦{司会者|しかいしゃ}→司会者：20470_shikaisha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{新郎|しんろう}→新郎：12982_shinrou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{言|い}い⟦{間違|まちが}えて→間違える：01109_machigaeru⟧、⟦{会場|かいじょう}→会場：01269_kaijou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{笑|わら}い→笑い：02641_warai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{包|つつ}まれた。
examples.english: The MC got the groom's name wrong, and the whole room burst into laughter.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
Transitive: the word said wrongly takes ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ (⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{言|い}い{間違|まちが}える). No intransitive pair.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{言|い}い{間違|まちが}い→言い間違い：08579_iimachigai⟧: a slip of the tongue (noun)
- ⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{言|い}い{間違|まちが}える: to get a name wrong
- A⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧B⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{言|い}い{間違|まちが}える: to say B when one meant A

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {聞|き}き{間違|まちが}える / ⟦{書|か}き{間違|まちが}える→書き間違える：21977_kakimachigaeru⟧: the same 〜{間違|まちが}える pattern for hearing and writing
- ⟦{口|くち}が{滑|すべ}る→口が滑る：30585_kuchigasuberu⟧: to let slip something one should not have said — about content, not a wrong word
